current.scope: Exact promotion of the fully qualified zero-factor candidate; no other recorded live source/support change. Historical live flags describe older states. Source identity is separate from successful live regression/retention gates.

limits: Post-selection case-isolated replication of two target forms, two large hot unequal regressions and two failed-proof controls. Same sources and global warmup protocol; one case per fresh process. Conditional intervals are not independent confirmatory significance claims.
